notes.title: 🌍 New Update: Multilingual Support! 🚀
notes.notes:
🗣 Newly Supported Languages:
🌍 English 🇬🇧
🌍 French 🇫🇷
🌍 German 🇩🇪
🌍 Dutch 🇳🇱
🌍 Russian 🇷🇺

🔧 How to Change Language?
Navigate to Settings and choose your preferred language from the dropdown menu. The UI and in-game text will automatically update!

This update enhances accessibility and ensures a smoother experience for players worldwide. Let us know if you encounter any translation issues or if you’d like to see more languages added in future updates!

Thank you for your continued support! Enjoy the game in your language! 🌏🎮

notes.title: Gain +100 FPS, enjoy optimized lasers and extended draw distance for an even ric
notes.notes:
In this major update, we’ve focused on optimizing performance and enriching the game world. Here are the key improvements:

Performance Optimizations:

+100 FPS Extra!
Thanks to intelligent object culling and advanced rendering tweaks, the game now runs more fluidly than ever.
Revamped Lasers:
We completely redesigned the lasers to reduce their performance impact while maintaining a striking visual effect.
Extended Draw Distance:
The rendering range has been increased to minimize clipping, providing a wider and clearer view of the world.
Content and New Features:

New Sections and Zones:
Several new zones have been added and some sections modified to enrich the gameplay experience and increase the challenge.
New Characters (in development):
New characters are currently in development to diversify gameplay and offer more customization options.
Dynamic Vignette Effect (in development):
A dynamic vignette effect, linked to descent speed, is being implemented to enhance the sense of speed and immersion.
We hope these improvements will transform your gameplay experience, making it even smoother and more immersive. Dive into this enriched world and share your feedback with us!

notes.title: Enhanced Performance & Custom Graphics Menu
notes.notes: In this update, we've made significant performance optimizations that boost FPS and ensure smoother gameplay. Additionally, we've added a comprehensive graphics quality menu that allows you to tweak settings such as texture quality, shadow resolution, and more, to suit your hardware and preferences. Enjoy a more responsive and personalized gaming experience without compromising on visuals. Dive in and experience the difference!

notes.title: Enhanced Fall Animations for a Smoother Experience
notes.notes: In our latest update, we've completely overhauled the fall animations to deliver a significantly improved visual and gameplay experience. Enjoy smoother transitions, more lifelike physics, and an overall enhanced aesthetic that makes each descent truly impactful. Dive into a game where every fall not only challenges you but also feels like a cinematic moment. Get ready for a more immersive and polished adventure!

notes.title: New Immersive Soundtrack
notes.notes: We're excited to unveil our latest update featuring a completely overhauled and dynamic soundtrack. With this update, each area in the game now has its own musical theme that adapts to environmental conditions and your progression. Whether you're descending into deep, intense zones or exploring lighter areas, the adaptive music responds to changes in height and surroundings, enhancing the overall immersion. Enjoy a rich auditory experience that brings every moment of your adventure to life—no more static loops, just evolving soundscapes that match your pace and style!

notes.title: Smooth Respawn & Enhanced Reset
notes.notes:
In this update, we've completely revamped the character reset process. Say goodbye to long loading screens—when you reset your character, the system now:

Temporarily disables the CharacterController to accurately reposition the parent object at the designated spawn point.
Resets the Animator after repositioning, ensuring a smooth transition between animations.
Instantly respawns your character in-game without the need to reload the entire game.
These improvements provide a seamless, uninterrupted gaming experience. Jump right back into the action and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Buffer Zones and Moving Obstacles
notes.notes: In this update, we've integrated buffer zones between sections so that players can adapt their speed before entering the next stage. Additionally, animated obstacles have been added within these zones to intensify the challenge and energize the gameplay. Get ready for a more immersive and strategic gaming experience!

notes.title: Rendering update
notes.notes:
Dive even deeper into The Fall with this update, enhancing the experience and adding new content!

✨ Graphics Improvements & Lighting Effects
Improved rendering for an even more immersive fall.
Added dynamic lighting effects, making the experience more intense and visually captivating.
🏆 New Playable Characters
Now you can choose from multiple characters to try and beat your records.
🏗️ New Challenges to Overcome
Added fresh obstacles and elements, making each descent more strategic and unpredictable.
Push your limits and try to reach depths never explored before! Thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🎮🔥
